title: cc-insights 品牌叙事宣传片
description: Two deliverable assets: (1) a 3.4-second hero shot at 1080p60; (2) a 30.2-second brand narrative video at 1080p60 with shaonv Mandarin voice + ambient BGM muxed in. Suitable for README banner, Twitter video, and a feature share.

renders.notes: Silent. Use this for README banner / Twitter header.

renders.qualifier: 10-segment concatenation via ffmpeg concat, video only (-qh source segments)
renders.command: ffmpeg -y -f concat -safe 0 -i <files> -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p renders/final/brand-concat-1080p.mp4

renders.prompt: calm tech ambient, soft pad, educational explainer style, gentle pulse, no lyrics
renders.use_case: background music for technical explainer video

renders.command: ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -i brand-concat-1080p.mp4 -i voice.wav -i bgm.wav -filter_complex "[1:a]atempo=1.32,volume=1.0[v]; [2:a]atrim=0:31,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,volume=0.18[b]; [b][v]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest[mix]" -map 0:v -map "[mix]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest brand-final-1080p.mp4
renders.notes: Distribution-ready 1080p with synced voice + ambient BGM.

reproduce.render_qh: cd src && for f in hero.py brand/s0*.py; do uv run manim -qh --media_dir /tmp/qh_$f $f <ClassName>; done
reproduce.voice: mmx speech synthesize --text-file tts/voice-text.txt --voice female-shaonv --format wav --out tts/voice.wav
reproduce.music: mmx music generate --prompt 'calm tech ambient, soft pad, educational, gentle pulse, no lyrics' --instrumental --format wav --out bgm/bgm.wav
reproduce.final: ffmpeg filter_complex atempo(voice) + atrim/bgm + amix → brand-final-1080p.mp4

notes: Skill anti-patterns followed throughout: explicit grouped imports, no MathTex, no Axes.get_axis_labels, brand color centralized in src/_lib.py. One real bug: manim 0.20.1 has no `Polyline` — used `VMobject.set_points_as_corners(...)` instead in hero.py and s10_end.py.

changes: s02/s09 real terminal (Catppuccin Mocha, JetBrains Mono, status bar, ✓ echo)
s06 hero metric 消息数 in brand color, larger bold values
s07 giant 24.5min + 行业均值 2.1min baseline
s10 ★ Star on GitHub CTA button + slogan
